_about: Names derived by algorithm (rules.md) from goldenDawn grids in tablets.json, each compared with published spellings. Comparison ignores case and treats C=K, U=V, I=Y as one letter. verified=true means 2+ sources print the same spelling. publishedDifferent shows sources that print something else. Source keys: see sources.md. DEE = Dee's own name lists in Sloane 3191 (built mostly from the 1584 letters, so a mismatch with DEE often just marks a 1584/1587 letter change). AZ0TH = an independent recomputation from the Tabula Recensa (only rows where it differs from Dee were listed).
